title: AO/422/2011 of MON MOHAN KOHLI Vs MASTER RISABH KOHLI and ANOTHER

paras.text:
MCC No. 89 of 2012
CLMA No. 1333 of 2012
In
AO No. 422 of 2011
Hon'ble Prafulla C. Pant, J.
Mr. H.C. Joshi, Advocate, present for
the appellant.
Mr. Bhupesh Kandpal, Advocate,
present of the respondent No.2.
The appellant has failed to take steps
and remove the defects even after being
given several opportunities for the same.
Therefore, the Restoration
Application (MCC) No. 89 of 2012, as
well as Delay Condonation Application
(CLMA) No. 1333 of 2012, are hereby
dismissed for non prosecution.
Registry is directed to send the record
to the Record Room, as appeal stands
dismissed vide this Court's order dated
03.01.2012.
